violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress (26 TAC §747.2309(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress
violation_type.typical_finding: A crib mattress had  rip  that exposed the foam filing. The rip is in the middle of the mattress, making it non-waterproof and non-washable.
